title: SnapshotFixture
description: Schema for a snapshot fixture in __fixtures__/snapshot/. Captures current engine behaviour with no source claim. Asserts NO UNINTENDED CHANGE. MUST NOT have a source block.

caseId.description: Unique identifier. Must NOT appear in the golden/ directory.

capturedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant when the snapshot was generated

engineVersion.description: Version of the panchang-engine package at capture time

ruleEngineVersion.description: RULE_ENGINE_VERSION from engine.ts at capture time

captured.description: The engine output at capture time. This is what the regression test compares against.

approved.description: Always false for snapshots — they capture behaviour, not correctness.

_comment.description: Optional human-readable note. DO NOT use this field to claim correctness.
